plugins.name: Surge XT
plugins.description: A deep hybrid synthesizer with a flexible modulation system, many oscillator algorithms, a large factory patch library and a built-in effects section. Ships with a separate Surge XT Effects plugin. The factory content pack is a second, larger download.

plugins.name: Dexed
plugins.description: A multi-platform FM synthesizer closely modelled on the Yamaha DX7. It loads DX7 SysEx patch banks, so thousands of existing patches work as they are.

plugins.name: OB-Xf
plugins.description: A virtual analog synthesizer in the style of the Oberheim OB-X family, a continuation of OB-Xd. Warm polyphonic pads, brass and basses from a compact interface.

plugins.name: Odin 2
plugins.description: A semi-modular polyphonic synthesizer with three oscillators, three filters, a modulation matrix, a step sequencer and an effects section. Many wavetables and a large preset library are included.

score.note: Download comes from a rolling release tag.

linux-x86_64.post_install_notes: The download is a rolling release tag; if the checksum no longer matches, the catalogue is out of date.

plugins.name: Dragonfly Reverb
plugins.description: Four reverb plugins in one download: Hall, Room, Plate and Early Reflections. Simple controls and a clean, musical sound, based on the Freeverb3 reverb library.

plugins.name: DPF-Plugins
plugins.description: A collection of 15 small plugins from the DISTRHO project, among them the MVerb reverb, 3 Band EQ, the Nekobi bass synth, Kars string synth, PingPongPan and ProM. Licences differ per plugin (GPL and ISC).

plugins.name: Airwindows Consolidated
plugins.vendor: Chris Johnson (Airwindows), ported by Paul Walker
plugins.description: Around 400 of Chris Johnson's Airwindows effects in a single plugin: saturation, dynamics, filters, tape and console emulations, reverbs and more. Pick an effect from the list inside the plugin.

score.note: Download comes from a rolling release tag.

linux-x86_64.post_install_notes: The download is a rolling release tag whose file name changes with each drop; if the checksum no longer matches, the catalogue is out of date.

plugins.name: Fire
plugins.description: A multiband distortion and saturation effect with per-band waveshaping, a drawable shaper curve, a built-in filter and an oversampling option. Suited to anything from subtle warmth to heavy destruction.

plugins.name: master_me
plugins.description: An automatic mastering plugin for live streaming, podcasts and music: levelling, compression, EQ and limiting in one small chain that adapts to the incoming signal.

plugins.name: Wolf Shaper
plugins.description: A waveshaper with a graph editor: draw the transfer curve, bend segments and add points. Includes oversampling and pre/post filters.

plugins.name: Six Sines
plugins.description: A small synthesizer built from six sine-wave operators that modulate each other in any direction: FM, ring modulation and feedback from one compact matrix. Fast to program, with a distinctive sound.

plugins.name: Vital
plugins.description: A spectral warping wavetable synthesizer with a visual, drag-and-drop interface, three oscillators, a flexible modulation system and built-in effects. The download is free but needs an account at vital.audio, so it is a link here; once you install it, Slimphonic finds it.

score.note: Free with an account; the binary cannot be redistributed.

linux-x86_64.post_install_notes: Download needs a free account at vital.audio. After installing, the plugin appears in the Instruments tab.

plugins.name: JC303
plugins.description: A bass synthesizer modelled on the Roland TB-303 Bass Line: a sawtooth or square oscillator through a resonant diode-ladder filter, with accent, slide and an envelope that gives the classic acid squelch.

plugins.name: Cardinal
plugins.description: A virtual modular synthesizer: the VCV Rack module system and its open-source module collection as a plugin, with a patch-cable user interface. Ships as three plugins (Cardinal, Cardinal FX and Cardinal Synth) in one bundle. A very large download.

linux-x86_64.post_install_notes: Large download: about 1.1 GB, and about the same again on disk. Contains the three Cardinal plugins in one bundle.

plugins.name: Shortcircuit XT
plugins.description: A multi-sample sampler and synthesizer: zones and groups, a modulation matrix, filters and effects per part, and a growing library of sample formats. Still in alpha; the build offered here is the rolling nightly, so expect rough edges and a checksum that changes.

linux-x86_64.post_install_notes: Alpha software from the nightly build. The VST3 in the same archive crashes when loaded here, so only the CLAP is installed.

plugins.name: LSP Plugins
plugins.description: A large collection of about 200 audio effects and tools in one CLAP file: compressors, gates, expanders, equalizers, delays, reverb, spectrum analyzers, a sampler and more, each in mono and stereo flavours. Precise, well documented and light on the CPU.

linux-x86_64.post_install_notes: Needs the 7z tool (p7zip) installed to unpack. The 3D view library installs next to the plugin.

plugins.name: Ildaeil
plugins.description: A plugin host inside a plugin: load another plugin (LV2, VST2, VST3, CLAP, JSFX and more) into an Ildaeil slot to run it in a Carla-based bridge. Comes as an effect, a synth and a MIDI variant in one CLAP bundle. Useful for formats Slimphonic cannot load by itself.

linux-x86_64.post_install_notes: A 75 MB download because it carries the Carla bridge programs.

plugins.name: Stochas
plugins.description: A probabilistic step sequencer that plays notes through whatever instrument follows it: each step has a chance of firing, so patterns drift and vary from bar to bar. It makes no sound itself; it is a note effect.

score.note: Chance-based sequencer; makes no sound itself.

linux-x86_64.post_install_notes: A note effect: it sends notes, so route its output to an instrument.

plugins.name: Monique
plugins.description: A monophonic bass and lead synthesizer with a deep modulation system: a morphing sound engine and several envelopes and LFOs. Originally the Monoplugs Monique, relaunched as open source by the Surge Synth Team.

plugins.name: OctaSine
plugins.description: A frequency-modulation synthesizer with four operators, written in Rust. Simple to program, light on the CPU, with four LFOs and a clean interface.

plugins.name: lamb
plugins.description: A lookahead compressor and limiter that stays soft: a transparent dynamics processor for mastering and bus work, with a lookahead that avoids pumping. Written in Rust.

plugins.name: NeuralRack
plugins.description: A guitar amp and cabinet rack: loads neural amp models (NAM and AIDA-X) and impulse responses, with a noise gate, EQ and a few effects around them. Bring your own model files.

score.note: Neural amp models plus cabinet IRs.

linux-x86_64.post_install_notes: Needs your own neural model (.nam or .json) and impulse response files; none are included.

plugins.name: Ratatouille
plugins.description: A neural model and impulse-response loader for guitar and bass: runs NAM and AIDA-X captures through two slots with a cabinet convolver and a few tone controls. Bring your own model files.

score.note: Neural capture loader for guitar and bass.

linux-x86_64.post_install_notes: Needs your own neural model and impulse response files; none are included.

plugins.name: BYOD
plugins.description: Build-your-own guitar distortion: wire up a chain of distortion, amp, filter and modulation modules in any order, with models of classic pedals and circuits. A guitar effects pedalboard in one plugin.

plugins.name: Chow Tape Model
plugins.description: A physical model of a reel-to-reel tape machine: hysteresis, wow and flutter, tape loss and degradation. Adds the warmth and wobble of tape. Started as a Sony TC-260 emulation.

plugins.name: Chow Multi Tool
plugins.description: A multi-purpose audio effect: pick a processor (EQ, filters, waveshaper, mid/side and more) and shape it on screen. A compact toolbox for quick mixing jobs.

plugins.name: ChowKick
plugins.description: A kick drum synthesizer based on old-school drum machine circuits: a resonant filter excited by a pulse, with a few controls for tone, decay and punch.

plugins.name: Geonkick
plugins.description: A percussion synthesizer for kicks, snares, claps, hi-hats and effect sounds: layered oscillators with envelopes, filters, distortion and a compressor, plus a built-in kit manager.

linux-x86_64.post_install_notes: Only available as VST3; Slimphonic loads it as a VST3 plugin.

plugins.name: RipplerX
plugins.description: A physically modelled synthesizer: a resonator excited by a mallet or noise, with two resonators, partial control and many material models, in the spirit of AAS Chromaphone. Good for bells, marimbas and strange plucked sounds.

linux-x86_64.post_install_notes: Only available as VST3; Slimphonic loads it as a VST3 plugin.

plugins.name: FILT-R
plugins.description: A filter modulator: draw a pattern and let it sweep the cutoff in time with the music, in the spirit of ShaperBox and FilterShaper. Rhythmic filtering, gating and sidechain-style ducking from one curve.

linux-x86_64.post_install_notes: Only available as VST3; Slimphonic loads it as a VST3 plugin.

plugins.name: ZL Equalizer 2
plugins.description: A dynamic equalizer with up to 16 bands, each of which can be static, dynamic or side-chained, with several filter types, optional linear-phase mode and a spectrum display.

linux-x86_64.post_install_notes: Only available as VST3; Slimphonic loads it as a VST3 plugin.

plugins.name: Vitalium
plugins.description: The open-source core of the Vital wavetable synthesizer, built without Vital's factory content, as part of DISTRHO Ports. There is no binary download: install it from your distribution, then it appears in the Instruments tab.

score.note: Open-source Vital; install from your distribution.

linux-x86_64.distro_hint: Packaged as vitalium-vst3 or distrho-ports on Arch (AUR), KXStudio and some Debian-based distributions.
linux-x86_64.post_install_notes: No binary release exists. Install the distribution package, then Slimphonic finds it. It starts without Vital's factory presets.

plugins.name: Aeolus
plugins.description: A pipe organ emulator built on additive synthesis, a plugin version of the Aeolus organ: a church-organ sound for playing or writing organ parts. Needs no sample libraries.

score.note: A pipe organ, nothing else like it here.

plugins.name: PeakEater
plugins.description: A wave shaper and clipper: it eats the peaks of a signal with an adjustable curve, for loudness, drive and distortion. Small and quick to use. The latest release dates from 2023.

plugins.name: RoomReverb
plugins.description: A mono or stereo to stereo algorithmic reverb with a large set of room presets: add space to recordings with early reflections, a tail and a few simple controls.

plugins.name: Terrain
plugins.description: A wave terrain synthesizer: the oscillator reads a two-dimensional surface along a path you shape, which gives evolving timbres that ordinary wavetables do not.

score.note: Wave terrain synthesis, an unusual oscillator.

plugins.name: Actuate
plugins.description: A subtractive and additive synthesizer combined with a sampler and a granulizer. Written in Rust.

score.note: Synth, sampler and granulizer in one.

plugins.name: SpectMorph
plugins.description: A spectral synthesizer that morphs between analysed instrument sounds (winds, strings, voices) to make hybrid timbres that still sound natural. Controlled by a morph plan you edit in its own window. This is a beta release.

linux-x86_64.post_install_notes: Beta release. SpectMorph also needs its instruments and fonts in ~/.local/share/spectmorph, which this install does not place: download the same release tarball from the project page, unpack it and run its install.sh, or install the distribution package.

plugins.name: Vitalium Verb
plugins.description: The reverb module from the Vital synthesizer as a stand-alone effect: a lush algorithmic reverb with size, decay, pre-delay and filtering controls, ported to Rust. Built on Ubuntu 22.04.

score.note: The Vital synth reverb as a plugin.

plugins.name: sfzq
plugins.description: A small sampler that plays SFZ instruments and SF2 soundfonts, written for Linux. It is the player only: bring your own instrument files.

linux-x86_64.post_install_notes: No sounds are included: it needs .sfz or .sf2 files, which you load from its own window.

plugins.name: Floe
plugins.description: A streamlined sample-based instrument platform: it loads and plays sample libraries in the Floe format, with layers, a filter and effects. The libraries themselves are separate downloads.

score.note: Sample library player; libraries are separate.

linux-x86_64.post_install_notes: Plays Floe libraries, which are downloaded separately from floe.audio (often several GB each). Without one it makes no sound.

plugins.name: plugdata
plugins.description: Pure Data as a plugin: visual patching to build synths, effects and generative tools inside your DAW, with the ELSE collection of externals included. Ships as an instrument and an effect plugin. A large download.

score.note: Pure Data as a plugin. Large: 290 MB.

linux-x86_64.post_install_notes: Large download: about 290 MB, and about 150 MB on disk once installed (two plugin files). A whole patching environment: the first start indexes its objects and can take a moment.

plugins.name: AIDA-X
plugins.description: A neural amp and pedal modeller: it runs trained models of guitar amps and effects in real time, with an EQ, a gate and a cabinet impulse response around the model. Bring your own model files.

linux-x86_64.post_install_notes: Loads AIDA-X and NAM-style model files; none are included. Download models from the AIDA DSP model zoo.
